info.title: Township FloodOps API
info.description: Upload-first site projects with source hashes, readiness checks, immutable imported models and native SWMM pipe comparisons. Uploaded files do not establish field calibration. The separate illustrative catalog retains immutable storms, inspections and conceptual intervention presets. Poll run status before fetching results. Idealised reference checks do not establish site or 2D surface validation. High tailwater remains unsupported for the illustrative catalog. One API worker per runtime directory.

status_definitions.title: Status Definitions
status_definitions.description: Physical basis and thresholds used for each pipe/node status. Unestablished status is unknown.

frames.title: Frames
frames.description: Chronologically ordered; returned only after success.

position_m.description: Surface grate position, not the node invert.

status_definitions.title: Status Definitions
status_definitions.description: Physical basis and thresholds used for each pipe/node status. Unestablished status is unknown.

surcharge_duration_s.title: Surcharge Duration S
surcharge_duration_s.description: Elapsed time during which at least one node is surcharged; overlapping nodes count once.

position_m.description: Node invert position; Three.js mapping is [x,z,-y].

flow_m3s.title: Flow M3S
flow_m3s.description: Signed flow in the conduit's from-to direction.

z.title: Z
z.description: Elevation in metres relative to an assumed local datum.

input_snapshot.title: Input Snapshot
input_snapshot.description: Full resolved model, storm, boundary and scenario parameters, not IDs alone.

input_hash.title: Input Hash
input_hash.description: SHA-256 of canonical resolved input JSON.

intervention.description: Explicit conceptual preset actions. Every run resolves a fresh baseline and records the exact input changes.

swmm_supported.title: Swmm Supported
swmm_supported.description: Only normal is enabled; high remains unavailable pending numerical checks for that preset.
